patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports experiencing fever, chills, and a headache starting three days after undergoing an open cholecystectomy. She has a history of an abdominal hysterectomy 16 years ago. She has been smoking one pack of cigarettes daily for 17 years.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Right-sided chest pain that increases on inspiration
Secondary_Symptoms: Productive cough for the last 12 hours

Social_History.Smoking_Status: Current smoker, one pack daily for 17 years

Review_of_Systems.Gastrointestinal: Surgical site below right ribcage, otherwise unremarkable

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate the patient presenting with postoperative fever, chest pain that increases on inspiration, and a productive cough, and determine the correct diagnosis.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’ve had fever and chills with a bad headache, and it started about three days after my open cholecystectomy. I’m also having right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath, along with a productive cough.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps on my skin with a central dimple. I’ve just mainly had the fever and chills, the headache, and the right-sided chest pain that worsens when I breathe in, plus a productive cough.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed needing to urinate more often than usual. My main issues have been the fever and chills, the bad headache, and the right-sided chest pain that’s worse when I take a deep breath, along with the productive cough.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—I’ve been feeling generally weak and not like my usual strength since the fever and chills started.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had difficulty dressing myself, though I feel generally weak and less able than usual because of the fever and chills.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. I’ve mostly just had the fever and chills, the headache, and the right-sided chest pain that worsens when I breathe in, along with my productive cough.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any itchiness on my skin. It’s mainly the fever and chills, the bad headache, and the right-sided chest pain when I take a deep breath, along with the productive cough.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles when you walk that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—my calves don’t cramp or hurt when I walk, and the pain doesn’t seem to improve once I rest; it’s mainly the fever and chills, the headache, and the right-sided chest pain that gets worse with deep breaths, along with my productive cough.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any unusual change in my stool color—no pale or clay-colored stools.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, or have you had any trouble gripping or holding onto objects lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands or trouble gripping or holding objects. It’s mostly that I feel generally weak and run down since the fever and chills started.”
